title: Read the supplied result pipeline
description: You can follow the given success and error wrappers through the three example inputs.

steps.description: Ok carries a value and applies supplied functions. Err carries an error and returns itself from map and and_then.
The supplied safe wrapper converts a normal return into Ok and a caught exception message into Err.
The snippet wraps integer conversion, square root, and division. The later pipeline uses the first two wrappers.

steps.question: Will an Err from safe_int call the float mapping function?
steps.answer: No. Err.map returns that same Err.

steps.description: The given run displays Ok(4.0), a square-root domain error, and an integer-conversion error. These results come from the supplied pipeline without additional exception handlers in the loop.
